_doc: Curated ambientCG (CC0 1.0) material sets for the engine's triplanar texture layer (docs/textures.md). tools/fetch_ambientcg.py downloads the 1K-JPG zip of each id, keeps Color / NormalGL / Roughness / AmbientOcclusion / Displacement and writes content/textures/<set>/{color,normal,rma}.jpg + meta.json. size = metres covered by one tile [u, v]. How the engine uses each set: content/textures/textures.json.
